				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_0  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Kitesurf and Windsurf School in Madagascar</h2></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_0 et_animated et-waypoint">
				<span class="et_pb_image_wrap "><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="714" height="365" src="https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/Kitesurfeur.png" alt="" title="" srcset="https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/Kitesurfeur.png 714w, https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/Kitesurfeur-300x153.png 300w" sizes="(max-width: 714px) 100vw, 714px" class="wp-image-204606" /></span>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_1  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_1">
				<span class="et_pb_image_wrap "><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1000" height="1501" src="https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/windsurf-mer-emeraude-madagascar-naish-z1000.jpg" alt="" title="" srcset="https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/windsurf-mer-emeraude-madagascar-naish-z1000.jpg 1000w, https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/windsurf-mer-emeraude-madagascar-naish-z1000-200x300.jpg 200w, https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/windsurf-mer-emeraude-madagascar-naish-z1000-768x1153.jpg 768w, https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/windsurf-mer-emeraude-madagascar-naish-z1000-682x1024.jpg 682w" sizes="(max-width: 1000px) 100vw, 1000px" class="wp-image-205627" /></span>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div id="desc_hebergement" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_1 et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_1">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_2  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><span>Discover the magic of kitesurfing and windsurfing in Madagascar at Mazava Loha Resort, ideally located in the heart of the emerald sea, just in front of the legendary spot known as &#8220;the pool.&#8221; This iconic site offers a flat and transparent lagoon, suitable for practitioners of all levels, reachable in just 4/5 minutes of sailing.</span></p>
<p>Explore the various spots in the emerald sea for incredible free-riding, waves at Nosy Toreky or the Suarez islet, or navigate right from our beach.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_2 et_pb_row_fullwidth et_hover_enabled et_pb_equal_columns">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_3 et_hover_enabled  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div id="desc_suite" class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Kitesurf School</h2>
<p>Our IKO instructor and two assistants, with 9 years of experience teaching kitesurfing in Madagascar, will safely guide you through your initiation/progression on the fabulous pool spot. Enjoy individual lessons, with a jet ski dedicated to the supervision and safety of students.</p>
<h3>Lesson Packages:</h3>
<ul>
<li style="list-style-type: none;">
<ul>
<li>Discovery Course 2 hours private lesson: €100.</li>
<li>10-hour Course private lessons: €500.</li>
<li>&#8220;Progression&#8221; Course in group lessons (max 3 pers): 1 hour / €35 per person with personal equipment.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_4 et_hover_enabled  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div id="desc_bungalow" class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_3  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Windsurf Center</h2>
<p><span>Whether you have your own equipment or are in rental/classes, the team at the Windsurf Center at Mazava Loha offers a complete range of services, including:</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>Services :</h3>
<ul>
<li>Rental of windsurfing and kitesurfing equipment (see our rates).</li>
<li>Free boat shuttle to various spots in the emerald sea.</li>
<li>Jet ski safety (first intervention free).</li>
<li>Launch/landing assistance (free).</li>
<li>Equipment storage (free).</li>
<li>Shower and equipment rinsing.</li>
<li>Bar.</li>
<li>Weather updates.</li>
</ul></div>
			</div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><strong>Kitesurf and Windsurf</strong> Equipment</h2>
<p>Our rental equipment, regularly renewed, is from the 2018/2019/2020 seasons. Windsurf boards are selected from FANATIC, sails from NAISH and DUOTONE, and all kitesurfing equipment is 100% NAISH.</p>
<p>Explore the pleasures of kitesurfing and windsurfing in the emerald sea in Diego Suarez, Madagascar, with Mazava Loha Resort. Book now for an unforgettable experience!</p></div>
